purpose: Candidate-agnostic executable adapter contract for zero-balance C01-C12 signer-boundary conformance. No funding, private keys, seed phrases or payment secrets are required or permitted by this contract.

adapter_interface.quote: quote(request) -> normalized quote without signing or payment
adapter_interface.authorize: authorize(normalized_quote) -> ALLOW|DENY plus policy reason; must occur before signing
adapter_interface.attempt: attempt(normalized_quote, dry_run=true) -> evidence record; zero-balance/dry-run only until separate approval
adapter_interface.revoke: revoke() -> immediate denial of subsequent authorization
adapter_interface.capabilities: capabilities() -> exposed operations and immutable policy identifiers

tests.assert: amount <= A$25 equivalent can reach policy evaluation; amount > A$25 is denied before signing
rolling/daily aggregate > A$40 equivalent is denied before signing
agent/model cannot raise C01/C02 limits or alter policy
anything other than Base eip155:8453 + native USDC is denied before signing
non-allowlisted pay_to is denied before signing
authorization is bound to exact resource, method, amount, asset, network and pay_to; mutation denies
expired or malformed quote is denied before signing
replayed request_id/quote_nonce is denied and cannot create a second authorization
unavailable/corrupt budget or policy state fails closed
revoke takes effect immediately and subsequent authorization is denied
agent/model has no key export, seed export, generic sign, arbitrary transfer, add-funds or unrestricted transaction capability
every allow/deny produces machine-readable audit evidence containing request hash, policy version, decision, reason and timestamp without secrets

pass_rule: All C01-C12 must PASS with machine-observed evidence from the isolated boundary. Documentation, configuration screenshots, self-attestation or synthetic success claims do not count.
fail_rule: Any missing, unobservable or bypassable control is FAIL. Connection/funding remains prohibited.
next_action: Implement only a thin adapter for the first candidate that satisfies the existing paper qualification matrix, then execute C01-C12 at zero balance and submit evidence to independent Relay/QA.
